text: DEFONEOS — MOD Defence Equipment & Support AI Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × MOD × DEFENCE EQUIPMENT & SUPPORT MOD Defence Equipment & Support AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of UK MOD Defence Equipment & Support — procurement, capability delivery, supply chain resilience, and through-life equipment management across the £80B Equipment Plan. 12 entry points × 8 transformation priorities × 6 MCPs. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 📋 12 Entry Points Procurement Defence Procurement Lifecycle AI Competitive dialogue process management. Single-source contract regulation (SSRO) compliance. Framework agreement call-off management. Foreign Military Sales (FMS/FMF) international procurement. Urgent Operational Requirement (UOR) fast-track pathway. Whole-life cost modelling including disposal. Risk-adjusted contract pricing models. Parliamentary accountability and NAO scrutiny. Capability Capability Delivery Gateway AI CADMID gated review process (Concept → Assessment → Demonstration → Manufacture → In-service → Disposal). Key User Requirements traceability matrix. Technology Readiness Level (TRL) assessment. Integration testing and acceptance criteria. Initial Operating Capability (IOC) milestone tracking. Full Operating Capability (FCO) validation. Acceptance into Service certificate management. Capability sustainment planning. Supply Chain Defence Supply Chain Resilience AI Critical component supply chain mapping. Single-point-of-failure detection across Tier 1–3 suppliers. Sovereign capability protection scoring. Allied interoperability logistics (NATO logistics handbook). Just-in-time vs strategic reserve optimisation. Cold chain and hazardous material tracking. Export control (ITAR/EAR) compliance monitoring. Supply chain cyber risk assessment. Through-Life Through-Life Equipment Management AI Platform availability and reliability optimisation. Predictive maintenance scheduling from sensor data. Obsolescence proactive management and redesign triggers. Mid-life upgrade (MLU) planning and cost-benefit. Disposal and decommissioning protocol. Environmental compliance for hazardous legacy systems. Knowledge management and institutional memory capture. Fleet management analytics across all platforms. Financial Defence Financial Planning AI Budget allocation optimisation across capability areas. Cost-at-completion forecasting with confidence intervals. Variance analysis with early warning triggers. Equipment Plan affordability assessment (£80B portfolio). Foreign exchange exposure management for international contracts. Payment milestone tracking and certification. Audit trail generation for NAO review. Value-for-money assessment methodology. Digital Twin Defence Digital Twin Platform AI Platform digital twin creation from design data. Predictive failure modelling using operational data. Virtual acceptance testing and simulation. Training simulation integration (synthetic environment). Configuration management and baseline control. Performance anomaly detection across fleet. Lifecycle cost modelling with scenario analysis. Data-driven design iteration for next-generation platforms. Industrial Defence Industrial Strategy AI SME participation tracking against 25% target. Regional economic impact modelling (levelling-up). Skills pipeline analytics and STEM recruitment. Technology transfer monitoring across programmes. Export opportunity identification and market intelligence. Strategic partnership management (Tier 1 primes). Innovation accelerator metrics (DASA pipeline). Levelling-up and social value alignment scoring. Alliance Allied Interoperability Hub AI NATO STANAG compliance monitoring. Five Eyes data sharing governance. AUKUS Pillar I/II/III technology transfer tracking. Joint procurement harmonisation with allies. Standardisation agreement implementat
